fieldOverrides.__comment: REQUIRED. Firestore auto-indexes every field and caps an index entry at ~1500 bytes, but tafsir explanations average 9-14 KB and peak at 145.9 KB. Without this exemption most imports FAIL with INVALID_ARGUMENT, and any that succeeded would roughly double storage cost for an index nobody queries — passages are always fetched by document id. Empty `indexes` disables ascending, descending and array-contains for this field.
Same reasoning: the run-length manifest is a large map fetched by id, never queried.
